name: PR416 state-only preforce candidate

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-state-only-preforce-candidate
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-state-only-preforce-candidate.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  ball-physics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-state-only-preforce-candidate
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install candidate contract locks
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cp .github/evidence/Pr416StateOnlyPreforceCandidateTests.cs src/ball-physics/tests/Pr416StateOnlyPreforceCandidateTests.cs

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run preserved ERR-001-006 locks
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          dotnet test src/ball-physics/tests/ball-physics-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=Stationary_AboveEnterThreshold_TransitionsToAirborne|Name=Rolling_AboveEnterThreshold_BelowMinVelocity_StillTransitionsToAirborne|FullyQualifiedName~Pr416StateOnlyPreforceCandidateTests"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

      - name: Characterize broad high-speed Rolling lock
        id: broad
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          dotnet test src/ball-physics/tests/ball-physics-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=Rolling_AboveEnterThreshold_TransitionsToAirborne"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

      - name: Require only the known contract conflict
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test "${{ steps.broad.outcome }}" = "failure"

  focused-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-state-only-preforce-candidate
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run current five-target fixture
        id: tests
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-stateonly-focused
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed|Name=BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose|Name=TacklesHappenInComposedPlay|Name=ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice|Name=sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"             --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-stateonly-focused.trx"             --results-directory artifacts/pr416-stateonly-focused             2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-stateonly-focused/console.log

      - name: Enforce main-relative target outcomes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import glob, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          required_pass = {
              "AControlledCarrierIsActuallyDispossessed",
              "BothOutcomesOccur_TheBallIsSometimesWonAndSometimesKnockedLoose",
              "TacklesHappenInComposedPlay",
              "sim_match_engine_shot_outcomes",
          }
          foul = "ATackleFoulIsGivenAsASlideTackleAndNotJudgedTwice"
          files = glob.glob("artifacts/pr416-stateonly-focused/*.trx")
          if len(files) != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"expected one TRX, found {files}")
          root = ET.parse(files[0]).getroot()
          seen = {}
          for elem in root.iter():
              if elem.tag.endswith("UnitTestResult"):
                  name = elem.attrib.get("testName")
                  if name in required_pass or name == foul:
                      seen[name] = elem.attrib.get("outcome")
          print("MAIN_RELATIVE_TARGET_OUTCOMES", seen)
          missing = (required_pass | {foul}) - seen.keys()
          bad = {n: seen.get(n) for n in required_pass if seen.get(n) != "Passed"}
          if missing or bad:
              raise SystemExit(f"target failure missing={sorted(missing)} bad={bad}")
          if seen[foul] not in {"Passed", "NotExecuted"}:
              raise SystemExit(f"foul test worse than main: {seen[foul]}")
          PY

      - name: Upload focused evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-stateonly-focused-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-stateonly-focused/
          if-no-files-found: error

  widened-corpus:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-state-only-preforce-candidate
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install preregistered widened census helper
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git fetch origin evidence/pr416-mechanism-census
          git show origin/evidence/pr416-mechanism-census:.github/evidence/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs > src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          p = Path("src/match-engine/tests/Pr416MechanismCensusTests.cs")
          s = p.read_text()
          s, ticks_n = re.subn(
              r"private const int Ticks\s*=\s*150_000;",
              "private const int Ticks = 324_000;", s, count=1)
          s, seed_n = re.subn(
              r"(0x0F1E2D3C4B5A6978UL,\s*\r?\n\s*0x00000000D1A6D05EUL,)",
              r"\1\n            0x5EED000000000003UL,", s, count=1)
          if ticks_n != 1 or seed_n != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"helper rewrite mismatch ticks={ticks_n} seeds={seed_n}")
          p.write_text(s)
          PY

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run preregistered widened corpus
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-stateonly-widened
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=MeasurePr416MechanismCensus"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"             --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-stateonly-widened.trx"             --results-directory artifacts/pr416-stateonly-widened             2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-stateonly-widened/console.log

      - name: Enforce preregistered evidence sufficiency
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import re
          from pathlib import Path
          text = Path("artifacts/pr416-stateonly-widened/console.log").read_text()
          rows = re.findall(
              r"PR416_TACKLE_CENSUS seed=0x[0-9A-F]+ won=(\d+) loose=(\d+) foul=(\d+) missed=(\d+) dispossessions=(\d+)",
              text)
          if len(rows) < 3:
              raise SystemExit(f"expected >=3 census rows, got {len(rows)}")
          rows = rows[:3]
          wins = sum(int(r[0]) for r in rows)
          dispos = sum(int(r[4]) for r in rows)
          print(f"WIDENED_SUFFICIENCY wins={wins} dispossessions={dispos}")
          if wins < 3 or dispos < 3:
              raise SystemExit("preregistered sufficiency floor not met")
          PY

      - name: Upload widened evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-stateonly-widened-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-stateonly-widened/
          if-no-files-found: error

  corrected-baseline-detector:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: evidence/pr416-state-only-preforce-candidate
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Generate projects and restore
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln

      - name: Run current in-possession detector as diagnostic
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-stateonly-inposs
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj             --no-restore             --filter "Name=sim_match_engine_inposs_gate"             --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"             --logger "trx;LogFileName=pr416-stateonly-inposs.trx"             --results-directory artifacts/pr416-stateonly-inposs             2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-stateonly-inposs/console.log

      - name: Upload detector evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-stateonly-inposs-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-stateonly-inposs/
          if-no-files-found: error
